unit: one source-attributed model output at one documented time

generationScope.allowedPresentationMedia: all; includes recordings of code-generated animation, 3D and interaction
generationScope.classification: review the generation workflow, not the extension, video appearance or model/platform name alone
generationScope.legacyExclusion: preserve existing direct-video IDs, original media and detail/API ID archives as uncounted context; no main lists, numbers or default search
generationScope.uncertainWorkflow: defer new candidates; do not infer code generation from an MP4/GIF or model label

workIdentity: frames, views, recordings and reposts of one output are not additional works
playEligibility: licensed or permitted on-site isolated demo with verified meaningful interaction; playback alone is not Play
batchSize: no artificial artwork cap; discover broadly, publish only verified unique outputs

publicationAuthority.readySubsetPolicy: accumulate verified subsets across two-hour collection runs; consolidate all ready unique works in the first daily run after 20:00 Asia/Shanghai, with one complete release/check cycle; unresolved candidates do not block the daily verified batch; no minimum artwork quota and no per-batch approval
publicationAuthority.scopeExpansion: outside the existing pelican all-date, all-presentation-media code-generation scope requires user direction

restrictedRetrievalFallback.trigger: normal public page, API or media retrieval is restricted
restrictedRetrievalFallback.onLoginChallengeOrConnectionFailure: record the exact failure, continue reachable candidates, request user action only if necessary

historicalHomepage: human-made 1988 film antecedent; preserved context record, not an AI output, not proof of the prompt's inspiration, no case number or additional work
detailSupplementaryViews: real timestamped frames or archived individual views, horizontally navigable; no new works, redraws or original replacement; complete composites stay folded
variantCount: every real independent output counts once in all works; only one representative per same-model same-day run group on timeline
uncertainDates: retain source-established month or year precision; do not invent a day
dateBasis: verified generation date or earliest documented source publication; never inferred release date

collectionBatching.deduplicationScope: published catalog plus all pending reviewed outputs
